title: The Empty Court
text: A throne room where every seat is filled by a suit of armour, sitting straight and empty, gauntlets on the armrests. The throne itself is bare. As you enter, the herald's armour turns its helm with a grind of rust and announces you, by name.

options.label: The Leader kneels to the empty throne, as a courtier should.

outcomes.text: The armour kneels back. The herald gives you safe passage and a sealed letter that no one can open, and no one dares to burn.

options.label: The highest-ranked House claims the empty throne for itself.

outcomes.text: The armour applauds, slowly, gauntlets clanking, and lets you take the throne's gold.
The armour stands, every suit, all at once, and draws.

options.label: Back out quietly, and leave the court to its empty king.

outcomes.text: The herald announces your departure too, and every empty helm turns to watch you out. It is an honour, of a kind, and word of it will get home.
